why: Q.3 gives the flight Brasilia -> New Delhi -> Vladivostok as a diagram over a longitude scale running 180 W to 180 E, with the three cities plotted on their meridians and Brasilia annotated '31st December / Sunday / Morning 11 o'clock'. The longitudes are what the time calculation needs and they exist only as positions on that drawn scale, so the diagram is attached. It leaks no answer: the two times asked for are not on it.
